record_type: Verified extraction of contract-origin native-governance vote events
scope: 58 events in 56 successful transactions, 13 proposals, 17 March 2023–10 October 2024, found in the preserved archive query corpus. Multiple events can update the same proposal ballot. This is not a claim of complete lifetime voting coverage.
attribution: The voter is the ERIS hub, not automatically the external transaction signer. One event explicitly names the hub voter; 57 match the unique hub address in the accompanying voted_weighted event. Those 57 retain the inference flag. Upstream callers and instructions are included; this ledger does not attribute every aggregated choice personally to Philipp.
